name: redthread
description: Generate red-thread portrait collages with Seedream 5.0 Pro. Optional segmentation is the only extra image processing.

interface.shortDescription: Generate a red-thread collage with Seedream 5.0 Pro.
interface.longDescription: This revision uses Seedream 5.0 Pro to generate a 3:4 two-panel portrait collage with a warm glowing upper silhouette, a faithful lower subject, theme-colored fiber paper, bilingual handwriting, and one wine-red pencil connector. The model creates all visual content; extra image-processing tools may only segment or extract the subject. User-configured model access is required. Visual consistency is the goal; exact source pixels and TTF rendering are not guaranteed.
defaultPrompt: Use $redthread to turn this portrait into a red-thread dual-scene collage.
Create a poetic bilingual red-thread collage from this photo.
Revise my Redthread collage while preserving the subject and anchor.
